answeredQuestions: Q3: Do the root README statements on features (deep-loop modes, skill hubs, routing and the advisor, hooks, code review output, scripts refusing unknown options, per-doc versions, playbook and catalog checks, CI gates) match v4.0.0.4 and the repository?

label: README.md:421 claims validate.sh runs 42 rules; validator-registry.json holds 41 rules, and v4.0.0.4 retired the improvement-folder check

README.md:421 says only two rules warn and never fail a run; the registry declares seven warn-severity rules (FRONTMATTER_VALUES, SOURCE_TAGS, GRAPH_METADATA_PRESENT, GRAPH_METADATA_CHILD_DRIFT, GRAPH_METADATA_SHAPE, DESCRIPTION_SHAPE, LINKS_VALID) and two info-severity rules
README.md:1278 says the doctor assets hold 19 YAML workflows; the directory holds 21 YAML files, 20 of them containing the operating_mode block the same sentence uses to define a workflow
README.md:881 says the mcp-click-up skill ships a 96-feature catalog and 37-scenario playbook; the shipped catalog holds 111 feature cards (50 cupt + 61 MCP) and the playbook holds 42 scenario files
README.md:881 attributes goals, bulk ops and webhooks to the official ClickUp MCP; the skill's own catalog says the hosted server has no tools for goals, bulk create or webhooks

README.md:1435 says mcp-click-up requires CLICKUP_API_KEY and CLICKUP_TEAM_ID; cupt signs in with cupt auth or cupt config --api-token, the MCP uses OAuth, and the release note says the old key lines are unused and safe to delete

README.md:325 --with-lazy-addons and --with-goal claims are verified: both option tokens exist in create.sh
README.md:445 SPECKIT_POST_VALIDATE=1 claim is verified: create.sh references the switch three times
README.md:1167-1168 create:changelog version-number and :auto/:confirm mode claims are verified against the command router
README.md:1336 clickup_official "No env var needed, one OAuth approval" claim is verified against mcp-tools.md and the INSTALL-GUIDE
README.md:1598 Release Notes link claim is verified: .skilled/changelog/skilled/ holds one entry per version, tail v4.0.0.1-v4.0.0.4
Code review output: no root README statement claims the pre-v4 review output shape; the Case line, status-line ending and Not checked line changes have no counterpart claim to update.
Gate 3 option C: README:252 and the FAQ (1519, 1522) name no Gate 3 options, so the option-C wording change has no README claim to fix.
Nested anchors: README:421 says rules check anchor markers; the nested-anchor error change has no README claim to update.
Unknown-option refusal: the root README makes no general claim that scripts refuse unknown options; create.sh carries the refusal and the doctor routers reject unknown flags. Q5 candidate.
Per-doc versions: no root README statement on the per-doc version model; shipped docs carry 4-part versions (chart catalog 0.23.0.16, click-up catalog 1.1.0.0).
The root README quotes no dotted version numbers: a v[0-9]+.[0-9]+ grep returns no matches.
